title: Siege of Rustenburg
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of Rustenburg", at revision 1370744863, opens: "The siege of Rustenburg was a siege that took place between 1880 and 1881 during the First Boer War. Boer forces of the South African Republic carried out the siege on Rustenburg, a British-controlled city inside of the Transvaal Colony, and captured it after three months." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q15693966, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1880 siege". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
